subject: Northbridge exec dinner — logistics, menu and transport (7/21)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Leland <ari.leland@northbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northbridge exec dinner — preliminary options for Tues 7/21

Hi Ari — looking forward to the onsite next week. Per our call, were lining up an executive dinner for Tuesday 7/21 (6:30pm start) and want to confirm a few logistics so we can lock the private room and transportation. Quick bullets: 

- Guest count: please confirm final headcount (we have 6 tentatively).
- Dietary: any allergies or strict preferences? we can do vegetarian/pescatarian-friendly tasting menu.
- Room: do you need a fully private dining room with AV for a short slideshow (~15 min)?
- Arrival timing: do guests prefer a 6:15 car pickup from the hotel or staggered arrivals?
- Budget target: are you comfortable with the upgraded wine pairing or should we stay to the standard tier?

Ive attached two options for menus and a rough ground transport estimate so you can see vendor pricing. If you confirm headcount and dietary by EOD Monday Ill close the booking.

Attachments: proposed-menus.pdf, ground-transport-estimate.xlsx

Thanks — Ill coordinate logistics on our side and loop in venue ops.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northbridge exec dinner — preliminary options for Tues 7/21

Thanks Irene — this looks great. Confirming details from our side: 

- Final headcount: 6 (me, Kate Morales, Daniel Cho, Priya Singh, Marcus Hale, Sean ONeill). I attached a quick guest list with titles.
- Dietary: two vegetarians (Kate, Priya), one pescatarian (Marcus), and one nut allergy (Daniel).
- AV: yes please — private room with HDMI + laptop, plus a small mic setup. We will run a 10-15 min deck around 7:10pm.
- Pickup: a single pickup from Hotel Atlas at 6:00pm for all guests works best.
- Wine: happy to do the standard pairing; no need to upgrade.

Please confirm once venue and transport are booked and share final menu. Thanks for handling logistics.

Best,
Ari Leland
Head of Partnerships
Northbridge Analytics
ari.leland@northbridge.com

Hi team — copied Marco's catering so they can see the headcount and dietary notes and confirm final menu items and AV setup. Marco's, can you confirm: private room availability for 7/21, a projector/HDMI run + small tabletop mic, and a single black SUV pickup from Hotel Atlas at 6:00pm for 6 guests (with 15 minute buffer)? Also confirm nut-safe prep for Daniel.

Notes for vendor:
- Headcount: 6
- Dietary: 2 vegetarian, 1 pescatarian, 1 nut allergy (requires separate prep station)
- Menu basis: see attached proposed-menus.pdf, prefer Option B tasting but please flag any items you cannot make nut-safe.
- Transport: see attached ground-transport-estimate.xlsx — we will proceed with the black SUV estimate if you confirm.

Marco's reply (inline):
> Hi Dev & team,
> 
> We can confirm the private dining room and AV (projector + HDMI + one tabletop lapel mic). We will produce a final menu that is nut-free on request and provide separate prep/labeling. We can also coordinate a single SUV pickup through our transport partner; ETA and driver details will be shared once we have the guest pickup address (Hotel Atlas).
>

> 
> - Marco, Events Lead, Marco's Catering

Ari — all set on our side. Summary and action items: 

- Venue: private dining room reserved 7/21, 6:30pm start (booking ref: #9873). Attachment: venue-booking-#9873.pdf
- Guest list: 6 confirmed (as listed). Final guest list attached for your records. Attachment: northbridge-guest-list.xlsx
- Menu: Marco's will deliver Option B tasting, nut-free versions for Daniel, vegetarian/pescatarian tracks confirmed. Final menu attached: confirmed-menu-final.pdf
- AV: projector + HDMI + small mic provided; please bring your laptop adapter if non-standard.
- Transport: single black SUV pickup from Hotel Atlas at 6:00pm; driver ETA will be shared by Marco's 24 hours prior. Attachment: ground-transport-estimate.xlsx

Next steps (owner):
- Marco's: send driver contact and final menu (by 7/14) — owner: Marco's (events@marcoscatering.com)
- Irene: share final reservation confirmation and venue ingress map with your team and venue ops (by 7/15)
- Ari: send any last-minute guest swaps or additional AV requirements (by 7/16)

If there are no changes I will send the final confirmations and venue ingress map on Wednesday. Thanks everyone — excited to host.

Best,
Irene Choi
